description: Zero‑dependency, ESM‑first Node.js framework that delivers Express‑style simplicity with Fastify‑grade speed—optimized for edge, serverless, AI & LLM workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the surge in edge‑computing and AI‑driven services by positioning yantravese as the only framework that ships zero‑dependency, ESM‑only code with built‑in type‑safe routing, automatic OpenAPI/GraphQL generation, and native compatibility with Cloudflare Workers, Deno and Bun. Emphasize the "Express‑style API + Fastify performance" tagline in the README and use the new "edge‑ready" badge to capture trending searches for "edge-runtime", "serverless" and "ai-ready".
download_hooks: Blazing sub‑millisecond request handling – benchmarks show 2× faster than Fastify on edge VMs.
Zero runtime dependencies means a tiny bundle (< 5 KB) and instant cold‑start on serverless platforms.
Fully typed routing API with automatic OpenAPI/GraphQL schema generation – no extra plugins required.
ESM‑first, Deno & Bun compatible out of the box – write once, run everywhere.
Built‑in streaming & async hooks make it ideal for LLM‑driven and real‑time AI services.
